tool_schemas.name: search_google
tool_schemas.description: Runs a Google search for the provided query and returns a persisted Search record containing the query and its ranked result set (URLs and associated metadata as captured). Results are returned as a single saved result set for that search request (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query is missing/blank, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to run searches, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the search budget/rate limit is exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: visit_page
tool_schemas.description: Creates a page-visit record for the given URL, fetches the page, and returns the stored visit including extracted text and basic metadata; if takeScreenshot is true, also creates and links a screenshot artifact for the same visit. This endpoint does not paginate because it returns a single visit record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid/unsupported URL, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot create visits or capture screenshots, NOT_FOUND if the target page cannot be retrieved, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if visit/screenshot limits are exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: take_screenshot
tool_schemas.description: Captures a screenshot and returns a screenshot artifact record stored in the requested imageFormat and storageBackend, attaching it to the specified pageVisitId or (if omitted) to the latest active browser session’s current page visit. This endpoint returns a single artifact (no pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid pageVisitId format or unsupported imageFormat/storageBackend, NOT_FOUND if the referenced page visit (or an active session/current visit when omitted) does not exist, CONFLICT if there is no active session/current page to capture when pageVisitId is omitted, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if screenshot capture is not permitted, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when screenshot limits are exceeded.

pageVisitId.description: Page visit id to attach the screenshot to; if omitted, uses the latest active browser session's current page visit

storageBackend.description: Storage backend where the screenshot will be stored

tool_schemas.name: list_search_queries
tool_schemas.description: Lists persisted search query requests visible to the caller, optionally filtered by status/provider/date range. Returns a paginated collection ordered by created_at desc. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot access search history.

status.description: Filter by search query lifecycle status.

requestFingerprint.description: Filter by the request_fingerprint associated with the originating client/request.

createdAfter.description: Return only search queries created at or after this timestamp (ISO 8601).

createdBefore.description: Return only search queries created before this timestamp (ISO 8601).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response.

tool_schemas.name: get_search_query
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single persisted search query by id, including its stored ranked results (0..100). Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist or is not visible to the caller, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when not permitted.

tool_schemas.name: update_search_query
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on a search query, including driving allowed status transitions (e.g., cancel). Returns the updated search query record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid transitions or inputs, and NOT_FOUND/UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the record is missing or inaccessible.

status.description: New lifecycle status. Must follow allowed transitions (queued→running|cancelled; running→succeeded|failed|cancelled).

errorMessage.description: Optional error detail when transitioning to failed; ignored unless status='failed'.

tool_schemas.name: list_page_visits
tool_schemas.description: Lists persisted page visit records visible to the caller, optionally filtered by status and source search ids. Returns a paginated collection ordered by created_at desc. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller cannot access visit history.

status.description: Filter by page visit lifecycle status.

sourceSearchQueryId.description: Filter to visits initiated from a given search query.

sourceSearchResultId.description: Filter to visits initiated from a specific search result.

url.description: Filter by exact requested URL (absolute http/https).

createdAfter.description: Return only visits created at or after this timestamp (ISO 8601).

createdBefore.description: Return only visits created before this timestamp (ISO 8601).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a prior response.

tool_schemas.name: get_page_visit
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single persisted page visit by id, including extracted content/metadata when available. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist or is not visible to the caller, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when not permitted.
